scores.visual_critic_note: Intentional Paul Tol colorblind-safe palette with HCL depth-lightness hierarchy and clean typographic hierarchy earn it a 7, but 2px margins make it feel cramped and the legend swatches show base palette colors that don't match the HCL-adjusted cell fills.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Area encoding is correctly proportional to value via d3.treemap().sum(), domains are data-driven, and color is categorically honest, but cellFill calls the stateful rng() for leaf lightness during render, creating a permutation-order dependency that breaks the permutation invariant for leaf colors.
scores.stress_test_note: Named transitions ('zoom'/'opacity') with explicit cell.interrupt() calls before each zoomTo correctly prevent mid-flight snaps; pointer events unify mouse/touch; click-only interaction avoids update storms; no cross-view dispatch means no feedback loop risk; stale closure in t.on('end') is neutralized by the interrupt mechanism killing prior end callbacks.
scores.cognitive_load_note: 8-color categorical palette sits at the warning threshold but the colorblind-safe HCL lightness gradient cleanly separates depth levels, zoom-to-focus interaction manages the ~516-node hierarchy progressively rather than all-at-once, and adaptive label suppression prevents small-cell clutter — complexity is well-controlled.

proposer: Moved text styling (fill, font-size, font-weight, font-family, pointer-events) from inline D3 attrs to CSS rules. Net reduction of ~8 lines.
